profile_text.body:
Arize AI describes itself as an agent observability, evaluation, and improvement platform aimed at helping teams continuously monitor, debug, and improve AI agents and applications in production. The company says its platform supports modern AI use cases including chatbots, RAG systems, copilots, and agents, and integrates with more than 40 models, frameworks, and tools, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, and DSPy.

Arize offers two principal products. Arize Phoenix is described as a source-available, self-hostable observability and evaluation platform built on OpenInference and OpenTelemetry standards, allowing developers to trace LLM calls, run evaluations, monitor RAG metrics, and track embedding drift while keeping data under their own control. Arize AX is the company's managed platform built on the same open standards, adding managed infrastructure backed by what the company calls an industry-leading observability datastore referred to as adb, along with advanced agent observability, online evaluations, and continual improvement workflows. The company also describes a product called Alyx, which it characterizes as analogous to tools like Cursor or Claude Code but oriented toward AI engineering, running evaluations, debugging issues, and improving agents autonomously.
